This appeal has been filed for setting aside order dated 26.09.2023 passed by the learned Exclusive Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Patna in connection with A.B.P. No. 8009 of 2023 arising out of SC/ST P.S. Case No. 17 of 2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 504,
506 Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.4780 of 2023(8) dt.08-05-2025 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(i)(s) and 3(2) (va) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, whereby the prayer for anticipatory bail of these appellants has been rejected.
